mentions.name: laconic
mentions.description: laconic is a research automation tool described as "a Ralph loop for Research". It manages a 4K context window so that tiny local LLM models can perform advanced research tasks requiring dozens of searches and building a knowledge graph, running at zero API cost.
mentions.problem: API costs for LLMs are getting ridiculous.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Working on laconic, a "Ralph loop for Research"

API costs for LLM are getting ridiculous. By managing a 4K context window, I can get tiny local models to do advanced research tasks that require dozens of searches and building a knowledge graph for $0.
